_comment: Deterministic issuer-segment -> market-risk group table (DSN-20261101-issuer-segment-lookthrough §3.1). Reviewed config, git. Rules are tried in order and the first match wins: (1) issuer_rules (scoped by SEC CIK, never by ticker alone; the only place a theme overlay such as ai_basket may be assigned); (2) standard_member_rules (us-gaap/srt members); (3) label_patterns (case-insensitive regex on the member's standard label; a label that matches patterns of two different groups is AMBIGUOUS and is never auto-mapped). Unmatched or ambiguous lines go to the model-classified queue (P3; a stub today) and their share falls back to the issuer's profile sector with flag segment_unmapped_fallback. SHADOW ONLY until the operator grants the issuer_segments store: nothing in scripts/lib/market_risk/ reads this file; config/issuer_segments.json (APPROVED entries) stays the only live source.

extraction._comment: Revenue concepts in preference order: the parser takes the first that appears WITH the segment axis in the filing's own period (§2.1). companyconcept is read for the same list to find the newest 10-K/10-Q.

issuer_rules.why: launch services and launch development (10-Q 0001628280-26-066880 Note 18); 'Space' matches no keyword
SI mixes advertising (comm) with AI compute and software; split by its ProductOrService lines (operator-APPROVED option A)
AI compute, solutions and infrastructure; ai_basket overlay assigned here only (theme set is operator-owned, §3.1 rule 4)
IBM Infrastructure is hardware (Z, Power, storage); the word means buildings elsewhere
IBM Financing: client and commercial financing

classifier._comment: Model-classified path (§3.2, P3). enabled stays false: P1 ships a stub that never calls a model. The acceptance gate below is deterministic and tested now.
